claims.scope: CLOB order amendment via amend() for POST_ONLY limit orders

preconditions.text: A user has an existing order in the CLOB whose parameters (price, amount, side) they attempt to modify via amend().; amend() enforces that only POST_ONLY orders can be amended, reverting with AmendNonPostOnlyInvalid() otherwise.; The amended POST_ONLY order has a price that would immediately fill the order, even partially.
